'''Bar'injar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] member of [[The Crucible]]&mdash;a slaver organization active prior to and during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. He held the rank of [[Magister Protector]] and, as such, was responsible for handling any threats to the organization. His name was reflective of his title in Crucible's language.

==Biography==
Bar'injar would convince [[Chantique]] to spare the life of [[Dace Golliard]] after his failure to capture [[Jarael]] and [[Zayne Carrick]], and began organizing a hunt for the two personally.<ref name="KotOR 44" /> Later, on [[Volgax]], he forced the captured Carrick to fight against a [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] named [[Ralthar Sitan|Snout]], following Chantique's plan to break the former Padawan in order to get revenge upon Jarael. He was eventually killed on [[Osadia]] by [[Demagol]] during his attack on the Crucible.
